name: promote_context_record
description: Append a lifecycle action (promote / retire / supersede) to a context record's hash-chained promotions ledger and apply it to the record — mirrors Stella's promotions.jsonl: chain_digest = sha256(prev_digest + canonical row)

record_id.description: Public record ID (ctr_…) or its stable id (slug)

action.description: promote pins a version active; retire ends the record's life; supersede marks it replaced

policy_version.description: The governance policy version this action was taken under

seq.description: This entry's position in the record's chain

chainDigest.description: SHA-256 hex chain digest of this ledger entry

status.description: The record's lifecycle status after the action
